Intermixed turbulence supplies the destabilizing pressure that exposes dependency.
An overhead canopy specifies the spatial shape of the cover.
Purification after mixture supplies the temporary uncovering of devotion.
Escape by separation moves the subjects out from under the material cover.
Denial despite knowledge marks the later state as re-covering rather than first ignorance.
Failure of fidelity makes post-rescue concealment relational betrayal.
Benefit-covering identifies the final kufur as ingratitude after rescue.

changed_reading.after: K-f-r can be the act of covering dependence again after crisis exposed it; the addressee is released from emotionally following that unstable cycle because the full trajectory returns to God.
changed_reading.before: K-f-r is a stable identity that disappoints the addressee.

context_deltas.mechanism: A wave physically covers like overhead canopies; danger strips devotion to an unmixed state, rescue separates the subjects onto land, and safety is followed by knowing denial, betrayal, and ingratitude. The focus k-f-r becomes dynamic re-covering after dependence has been exposed, so grief need not track each oscillation; return holds the entire sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical cover, purified crisis devotion, rescue, knowing denial, and ingratitude; I infer an uncovering then re-covering cycle; alternatively crisis devotion may be merely temporary rather than a consciously betrayed disclosure.
structural_cues: The sequence is cover, exclusive call, rescue, partial moderation, then denial by every betraying ingrate.

activation_trace.role: Dependent liability supplies the exploratory burden that the later non-substitution rule limits.
Personal return gives the nontransferable account its destination.
The day's severe event supplies the setting in which ordinary bonds fail as surety.
One thing standing in place of another is explicitly negated for both directions of kinship.
Direct descent supplies the strongest available human claim for proxy bearing.
Ignorance of outcome explains why present closeness can be mistaken for transferable security.

changed_reading.after: It also refuses an imagined surety relation: neither prophetic concern nor family closeness can carry another subject's possessed account.
changed_reading.before: The prohibition only regulates an emotion about another person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored parent-child negations deny that either can stand in for the other. This activates the focus's possessive and the dependent-liability edge of h-z-n: even closest kinship cannot transfer his disbelief or its account onto another bearer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal failed substitution and kinship; I infer that kufruhu remains nontransferably his and that grief must not become proxy liability; alternatively the h-z-n liability branch is form-near but not the primary grief sense.
structural_cues: Parent and child exchange grammatical positions under repeated negation, making non-substitution symmetrical.

activation_trace.role: Unconcealed knowledge anchors the divine side of the asymmetry.

Human knowing is explicitly bounded at future action and endpoint.
The self as the very identity of the subject makes the ignorance reflexive, not merely ignorance of others.
Future acquisition supplies an action whose result is not yet available to the acting self.
Loss of life supplies the unknown terminal location of the self's course.
Knowledge of an affair's interior makes divine knowing deeper than the subject's forecast.

changed_reading.after: God knows the action-source and whole course that even the acting self cannot narrate in advance; the final report confronts the self with more than its own remembered story.
changed_reading.before: God sees motives that other humans cannot see.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse repeats that no self knows its next acquisition or place of death, then returns to divine knowing. Focus knowledge of chests thus spans motive, future output, and endpoint, while notification corrects the subject's inevitably partial self-account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive human unknowns and repeated divine knowing; I infer that the focus report corrects deficient self-account across motive, deed, and end; alternatively the focus knowledge may be narrower, concerning present motives only.
structural_cues: Twice repeated wa-ma tadri nafsun is answered at the surah's close by inna Allaha alimun khabir.

remaining_uncertainties: The buried-seed and night/day models are branch-licensed analogies, not lexical replacements for k-f-r.
The h-z-n to h-z-z heart-abrasion mapping and the dependent-liability branch remain form-distant or secondary.
The noncoercive social implication from 31:15 may be strongest in the parent-child setting rather than universally generalizable.
strongest_changes: K-f-r shifted from a static identity to repeated covering, especially re-covering exposed dependence after rescue.
Return-report became a transfer of nonproxy liability that permits bounded companionship and removes pressure for coercive closure.
Knowledge of chests became active retrieval and correction of hidden microdeeds and incomplete self-knowledge, not generic omniscience.
The adjacent orientation, respite, crisis, kinship, and closing-knowledge sequences preserved several coexisting mechanisms rather than one final interpretation.
summary.what_was_special: Material cover, inward roughness, social liability, public script, bodily orientation, temporal course, and epistemic asymmetry all converged on the same focus constructions without collapsing into a single reading.

Delivered report supplies the later appearance of what had been buried.
A germ-bearing grain gives the remote focus branch a concrete contextual activator.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cover also resembles burial: a deed can disappear from view yet remain poised to emerge into report rather than cease to exist.
changed_reading.before: Covering only suppresses or hides truth.

Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy of delayed emergence, never as a replacement translation.

changed_reading.before: Return interrupts concealment only once at a remote endpoint.

It remains anchored by the focus branch in which darkness is a covering expanse, the focus return, and the contextual work/awareness clause. Downstream prose should label it a temporal-spatial analogy, not claim that k-f-r lexically means night.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The denier’s covering need not become the addressee’s interior roughness.** **ك ف ر B003–B004** is covering truth or favor; **ح ز ن B001** is rough sadness in the self and **B003** burdened care for dependents. The prohibition interrupts transfer from another’s concealment into the messenger’s interior. I infer that responsibility for care has a boundary: concern may remain, but denial must not roughen and occupy the caregiver’s self. The line reads as protection of moral labor from corrosive over-identification.
2. **Return converts covered work into report.** **ر ج ع B001/B005** is return and returned answer; **ن ب ء B002** news brought; **ع م ل B001** intentional work. Concealment is followed by return and then a report of deeds. I infer a reversal: what *kufr* covers in the present is made answerable through disclosed work. The future informing is forensic self-confrontation rather than new knowledge for God.
3. **Knowledge reaches the source from which outward acts issue.** **ع ل م B001** is clear knowledge; **ص د ر B001/B004** is chest/front and a source from which forms issue; **ن ف س** is absent here, sharpening the bodily source image. I infer inner source → outward work, while the verse explicitly supplies only knowledge of what the chests possess. The close reads divine knowledge as reaching action before manifestation, at its issuing interior.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:29 paired human work with **خ ب ر B001**, and 31:34 framed hidden processes with *ʿAlīm Khabīr*. The later repetition confirmed that the chest-source reading concerns knowledge of action during formation, before return makes it reportable.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Grief relieved by transferring the adjudicative burden.** Lexical evidence: `ك ف ر B001/B003` is covering and rejecting truth, `ح ز ن B001` is rough sadness in the self, and `ر ج ع B001` is return. Structural cue: the prohibition of grief is immediately followed by return to the divine speaker and consequential reporting. Assigned role: grief registers concern, but return relocates responsibility for final disclosure and judgment. Abductive move (inferred): the addressee need not internally carry a burden that an assured return mechanism will process. Reading change: `فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ` is not indifference to denial; it is release from assuming ownership of its outcome.

2. **Acts traced back to the interior from which they issue.** Lexical evidence: `ع م ل B001` is intentional action, `ن ب ء B002` is consequential report, `ص د ر B004` is a source from which forms issue, and `ص د ر B001` is the bodily chest; `ع ل م B001` is knowledge. Structural cue: reporting of what they did is followed by knowledge of what the breasts contain; 31:20 has already paired outward and inward layers. Assigned role: action is the observable product, the breast is its generative interior, and reporting reconnects the two. Abductive move (inferred): a complete account of intentional work must trace it to the inward source that formed it. Reading change: accountability includes the production path from hidden intention to public act.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:24 immediately confirmed that the outcome is handled outside the addressee's grief, through respite followed by compelled return. 31:28 then prevented scale from weakening the inward audit: plural creation is like one self while hearing and sight remain undiluted.

words.gloss_range: coordinating and resumptive opening that continues the prior contrast
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the ayah forward from the prior submitter case into its antithetical counterpart. The opening does more than append a sentence: it lets the direction-to-God grammar continue while the discourse turns from the believer's outcome in 31:22 to the denier whose return is claimed by divine speech.

words.gloss_range: open conditional subject introducing an unrestricted disbeliever case
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the condition as an unrestricted actor class: whoever takes up the act of denial falls under the following counsel and return sequence. Because the same conditional frame answered the submitter in 31:22, the contrast between surrender and covering-denial is grammatical before it becomes thematic.

words.gloss_range: completed conditional act of covering-denial, with ingratitude pressure in the surah context

Its root keeps the image of covering truth and ingratitude alive, while the singular Form I begins with one denier before the ayah later widens to plural reckoning; the adjacent contrast with 31:22 turns covering-denial against surrender.

words.gloss_range: completed plural action in the relative clause, treated as a deed-record
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) completes the relative phrase as a finished record ready for disclosure. The root frames the actions as worked, intentional output rather than a vague occurrence, and its plural perfect form keeps the record collective, matching the plural objects already returning and being informed. The phrase participates in a wider deed-accounting formula (6:159; 5:105; 16:91).
words.root_gloss_range: work, doing, performance, deed, and produced output; distinct from generic action when the contrast matters locally

topics.headline: completed deed record

topics.reason: QAC identifies a plural perfect verb completing the relative clause.

topics.headline: worked intentional output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the deeds as deliberate worked output, while the contrast with generic doing remains a lexical pressure rather than a separate translation demand.
topics.reason: The work/deed root supports intentional output, but the local phrase still simply names what they did.

topics.headline: deed-accounting formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a wider Quranic pattern of disclosure and accountability for deeds.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula references and same-surah recurrence.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the final knowledge clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the closing knowledge statement into the asserted ground for everything before it. Its scope binds the divine name, the knowing predicate, and the chest-domain together, so the earlier return and disclosure rest on already-established divine knowledge.

topics.headline: emphatic knowledge ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing is not an added attribute but the certainty-ground for return, disclosure, and consolation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify an emphasized nominal clause governed by the particle.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the accusative governed subject of the emphatic clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) fixes the knowing subject as the proper divine name, not a generic deity noun. Under the emphatic particle, the accusative name is syntactically framed while remaining the one whose destination and informing action have already governed the ayah; derivation debates around worship-worthiness or bewildered refuge converge on the same unique referent.
words.root_gloss_range: divine proper-name field linked to worship-worthiness; proposed refuge or bewilderment derivations remain interpretive pressure, not a different local referent

topics.headline: proper name under emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final attribute anchored in the same unique divine speaker and actor, not in an abstract theological label.
topics.reason: The word is a proper noun governed by the emphatic particle and anchors the predicate.

topics.headline: derivation and authority field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears worship-worthiness and human dependence as name-pressure while the local clause keeps the proper divine referent fixed.
topics.reason: Derivational debate may color the name but cannot replace the local proper-name function.

words.gloss_range: intensive stable knowing predicate of the emphatic clause
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيمٌۢ}} ({{tr:ʿalīmun}}) supplies the predicate of the emphatic clause, asserting stable divine knowing rather than mere presence. Its faʿīl pattern makes the attribute enduring and intensive, and the following phrase directs that knowledge into the chest-domain, so the ayah moves from informing them of deeds to knowledge of what is held inside. The exact formula recurs as a divine-knowledge closure (35:38; 11:5; 67:13).
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing, recognition, and comprehensive awareness; here stabilized as an intensive divine attribute

topics.headline: stable knowing predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closure asserts an enduring intensive attribute of knowing, not a newly acquired act of learning.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative predicate on the faʿīl pattern in the emphatic nominal clause.

topics.headline: outer record and inner knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees accountability expand from the disclosed deed-record to the inner reality behind it.
topics.reason: The predicate is immediately specified by the chest-domain complement after the deed-disclosure clause.

topics.headline: knowledge formula field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closure as part of a recurring divine-knowledge formula and a Luqmān knowledge thread.
topics.reason: The rows provide exact formula parallels and same-surah recurrence.

words.gloss_range: preposition specifying the domain of the knowing predicate
words.prose: The second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) does not leave divine knowledge abstract; it specifies the domain as what belongs to chests. Together with the earlier {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), the ayah pairs disclosure about deeds with knowledge of interior states.

topics.headline: knowledge-domain specifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attribute of knowing is targeted toward hidden interiority rather than left generic.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the construct phrase specifying the domain of the knowing predicate.

topics.headline: outer-inner scope pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two prepositions create a full accountability scope: outward deeds and inward contents.
topics.reason: The earlier and later prepositional complements are both local and contrast outer deed-content with inner chest-content.

words.gloss_range: construct abstract noun naming the possessed essence or reality of the chest-domain
words.prose: {{ar:ذَاتِ}} ({{tr:dhāti}}) is the construct head that makes the object of knowledge the reality belonging to chests. It can carry both possession and essence pressure, so the clause reaches more deeply than a mere list of things inside; the formula names the possessed inner reality as known to God.
words.root_gloss_range: possession, selfhood, essence, and what belongs to something; locally bound in a construct phrase

topics.headline: construct inner reality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar makes the known object a chest-bound reality, not a loose interior list.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after the preposition and in construct with the following definite plural.

topics.headline: essence and possession pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears both essence and possession in the phrase, while the local construct keeps those pressures tied to the hidden-knowledge formula.
topics.reason: The abstract form supports the dual pressure, but its local force is constrained by the fixed construct phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite plural chest-domain in the construct phrase, metonymic for hidden inner life
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصُّدُورِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣudūr}}) makes the hidden domain plural and definite: the closure reaches the class of chest-interiors, not one person's private feeling alone. The chest metonym houses concealed inner life; the root also lets containment and what issues forth from the interior remain in view, while the formula recurs as a divine hidden-knowledge closure (3:119; 3:154; 8:43; 35:38; 67:13).
words.root_gloss_range: chest, front, forefront, containment, and issuing-forth; local noun selects the container while allowing emergence pressure

topics.headline: definite plural interiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hidden interiority is distributed across the whole plural group under reckoning.
topics.reason: The word is a definite plural genitive complement in the construct phrase.

topics.headline: chest metonym and root directions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees chests as the concealed housing of inner life, with containment and emergence pressure present but limited by the concrete plural noun.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the chest-container sense; issuing-forth remains root-family pressure rather than the main sense.

topics.headline: hidden-knowledge formula and sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as a recurrent hidden-knowledge closure and notices the heavy opening sound reinforcing sealed interiority.
